name: B10-0180/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Georgia's worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Georgia's October 2024 parliamentary elections, which it says were not free and fair. It asks for an independent investigation into reported fraud before the results are recognised, for talks between the government, the president and the opposition, and for the European Union to redirect over 100 million euro of aid from the Georgian government to civil society groups.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament only calls for investigations, talks and a shift of EU aid.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, president, opposition, courts and civil society groups.
- **What happens next:** The EU may send a fact-finding mission and could impose sanctions on people found to have rigged the vote.
